title: Fix task addition and implement backend persistence for todos

requirements.text: Debug and fix the task addition functionality in the TodoInput component so users can successfully add new tasks to the todo list

quotes: can't add anything to the to do list now?

acceptanceCriteria: Users can type text into the input field and submit it
New tasks appear in the todo list immediately after submission
The input field clears after successful task addition
No console errors occur during task addition

requirements.text: Implement backend persistence for todo items so that all tasks and their checked/unchecked states are stored in stable memory and survive canister upgrades

quotes: persist the todo items for refresh

acceptanceCriteria: Todo items persist across page refreshes
Task states (checked/unchecked) are preserved after refresh
Task text content remains unchanged after refresh
Data survives canister upgrades without loss

requirements.text: Create a migration.mo file to safely upgrade the backend state from the current Map-based storage to stable storage without data loss
acceptanceCriteria: Existing tasks are migrated to stable storage
No data is lost during the upgrade process
The migration handles empty state gracefully

requirements.text: Verify that the frontend correctly loads persisted tasks on initial page load by calling getAllTasks and rendering them in the TodoList component
acceptanceCriteria: Tasks appear immediately when the page loads
Previously checked tasks display with checked state
Previously unchecked tasks display with unchecked state

constraints: Maintain the existing single-actor architecture in backend/main.mo
Do not modify frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts or other immutable paths
Preserve all existing passive-aggressive modal functionality
Keep the current warm earth-tone color scheme
nonGoals: Changing the visual design or color palette
Implementing task sorting or filtering features
